candidates.title: Path traversal in read_user_file
candidates.description: A caller-supplied name containing '../' selects a file outside base_dir.
candidates.root_cause: os.path.join is used without normalising the result or checking that it stays under base_dir.
candidates.intended_behavior: Only files directly under base_dir are readable by name.

evidence.description: no normalisation of the joined path

candidates.observed_result: Source establishes that name='../secret' resolves to base_dir/../secret and is opened; no preventing layer exists in the module.

remediation.strategy: Resolve the joined path and require base_dir to be a parent of the resolved path before opening.

likelihood.reason: any caller of the function can pass '../'

impact.reason: reads any file the process can read

confidence.reason: established from source by hunter and verifier; not observed at runtime
